command:
sha=$(gh pr view --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) || exit 1
run=
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  run=$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --commit "$sha" --event pull_request --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')
  [ -n "$run" ] && break
  sleep 10
done
[ -n "$run" ] || { echo "no ci.yml run for $sha after 5m"; exit 1; }
gh run watch "$run" --exit-status --interval 30 >/dev/null && exit 0
sh .agents/scripts/ci-failures.sh "$run"
exit 1
output_tail:
CI run 42798165558 failed: https://github.com/PruszynskiJakub/norn-next/actions/runs/42798165558
- job 129768791359: integration (shard 4/4)
Read a job's failures (file, line, message):
  gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/check-runs/<job>/annotations" -q '.[] | select(.annotation_level=="failure" and .path!=".github") | "\(.path):\(.start_line) \(.message)"'
Only if that is not enough, the job's failed step log: gh run view 42798165558 --log-failed --job <job>
